service_area_desc: Our area of operation focuses on Vila Nova de Cerveira, but we perform services throughout the country and abroad. We know the region well to always choose the best routes.
service_airport_desc: Transfers from and to airports (Porto, Vigo, Santiago de Compostela, Lisbon, Faro) with guaranteed punctuality. Forget queues and stress, we handle your trip with all comfort.
service_corporate_desc: Mobility solutions for companies, transport of employees and business partners. Monthly billing and service management for your convenience.
service_pilgrims_desc: Support for pilgrims, backpack transport, and pickup at stages of the path. We know the hostels and difficult access points to provide you with the best assistance.

service_tours_desc: Personalized tourist itineraries to discover the best of Alto Minho and Galicia. We take you to the most emblematic spots with all comfort and time to appreciate.
service_mobility_desc: Adapted and personalized transport for passengers with reduced mobility or special needs. Our drivers provide all necessary assistance during boarding and disembarking, ensuring a safe and comfortable journey.
service_groups_desc: Hassle-free group travel. We have 7 and 9-seater vehicles, perfect for large families, groups of friends, bachelor parties, or lunch gatherings, ensuring everyone travels together.
service_events_desc: Safe transport for weddings, baptisms, parties, and social events. Enjoy the party without worrying about driving back. We schedule pickups to ensure the safety of all guests.
service_international_desc: We provide international transport services with all comfort. Whether to Spain, France, or another European destination, we offer a personalized long-distance service with experienced drivers.
service_cargo_desc: Courier service and urgent transport of small goods, parcels, documents, or luggage. We deliver by hand at the destination quickly and securely.
service_assistance_desc: Partnership with insurance companies for travel assistance. We ensure the transport of passengers and luggage in case of breakdown or accident of your vehicle, taking you to your destination or residence.
service_medical_desc: Non-urgent patient transport for medical appointments, physiotherapy treatments, or hemodialysis. Personalized accompaniment and waiting on-site if necessary (subject to booking).
service_school_desc: School transport for children with total responsibility and safety. Trusted drivers to take and pick up your children from school or extracurricular activities.

about_page_desc: Get to know Taxi Cerveira. Experienced drivers in Alto Minho. A history of dedication and safety in Vila Nova de Cerveira, Valença, and Caminha.
about_hero_text: We are the new face of transport in Vila Nova de Cerveira. We bring the freshness of a young brand combined with the safety of those who have known these roads for decades.
about_origin_text_1: Taxi Cerveira was born from the desire to reinforce mobility in our municipality. Those who live in Alto Minho know the privilege of being surrounded by stunning landscapes, but also the challenges of a vast region. We recognize the value and effort of professionals who have long served this land, but we felt that the community still yearned for more availability and options.
about_origin_text_2: We emerged, therefore, to add up. Our mission is to complement the existing offer, ensuring that there is always a ready answer for those who need to move. Whether for a medical appointment, shopping, or ensuring a group of friends returns home safely, we are committed to being present and serving with dedication.
about_identity_title: Young in age, Veterans on the road
about_identity_text_1: We may be a recent company on paper, but we are not novices in practice. Our team brings years of accumulated experience and thousands of kilometers of stories. This combination allows us to offer the best of both worlds: the energy, modernity, and freshness of a new brand, combined with the safety and wisdom of those who know every curve of the road like the back of their hand.
about_identity_text_2: We know the customs, festivals, and people of Vila Nova de Cerveira. We know that here, a taxi is more than just transport; it is sometimes the only connection to the world, a trusted neighbor, a friendly face. It is this trust that we want to honor in every trip we take with you.
about_value_proximity_desc: More than customers, we transport neighbors. Human treatment is our priority.
about_value_commitment_desc: Where the bus doesn't go, we go. We are where people need us.
about_area_text: Although based in Vila Nova de Cerveira, our commitment extends to the entire Alto Minho region. We cover locations such as Caminha, Lanhelas, Valença, Monção, Paredes de Coura, etc. We can, therefore, say with confidence that you can count on us for any area of the Viana do Castelo district and surroundings. Wherever you are, we offer you our availability.
